title: System Identification of an Octocopter in Hover using Full-Harmonic Orthogonal Multisine Inputs
summary: A new method for multi-input flight maneuver design for system identification is presented. The method consists of injecting "full-harmonic" orthogonal multisine signals into the flight control system. Orthogonality is achieved by repeating maneuvers with changing multisine polarities.
